create.name: Marleen Kooij
create.bio:
Marleen Kooij is a Dutch Quantum-Touch practitioner and teacher who runs her own practice, do mana, by the sea in Scheveningen, with a second room on the Kortenaerplein in Amsterdam. The name pairs 'do', meaning the way, with mana, a Hawaiian word for life-force energy, and her logo sets the Chinese character for the heart inside a labyrinth. Alongside the healing work she has a background in the arts and crafts, from ceramics and woodcuts to textiles and photography.

Her one-to-one sessions use Quantum-Touch together with Quantum-Share, a broader approach developed by the QTouch Trainingen team, and can be given in her practice room, at a client's home in central or west Amsterdam, or at a distance. She most enjoys showing people how to do the work themselves, and she teaches the Quantum-Touch Level 1 course as a weekend in Scheveningen, covering breathing and visualisation methods, the use of colour, sound and the chakras, working with children and animals, and distance sessions. Each month she also holds new-moon and seasonal circles for women in Scheveningen and Amsterdam, with ceremony, shamanic journeys and time spent with the cycles of nature.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch sessions
courses.description: Hour-long hands-on energy sessions in her Scheveningen or Amsterdam practice room, or at home in central and west Amsterdam for a small extra fee. She also works at a distance at a lower rate.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1 weekend workshop
courses.description: A two-day beginners' course in Scheveningen, with lots of practice in pairs, breathing and visualisation methods, colour and sound, and how to give distance sessions. Students receive a syllabus and a certificate; dates appear on her agenda.

courses.title: Maancirkel (women's moon circles)
courses.description: Monthly evening and afternoon circles for women in Scheveningen and Amsterdam, timed to the moon and the seasonal festivals. Each one brings ritual, a guided shamanic journey and sharing in a sacred space.
